EXP_A1_PULLBACK_EMA21.description: Requires price to temporarily retrace within 0.5 ATR of the 21 EMA while broader trend remains intact before generating a signal.
EXP_A1_PULLBACK_EMA21.hypothesis: Demanding a pullback toward the 21 EMA avoids buying/selling at local impulse extremes and improves entry timeliness.

EXP_C1_FIRST_STRUCTURAL_EVENT.hypothesis: Restricting setups to the first valid post-breakout bar eliminates redundant trailing trend signals and reduces clustering.
